acceptance_criteria.statement: Create prioritized upstream adoption and pattern-mining queue is represented in permanent machine-readable project state and fails closed when its invariant is violated.
Repository validation confirms catalog/provenance/usage/traceability consistency without unverified live claims.

definition_of_done: No unavailable live external behavior is represented as verified.
description: Create prioritized upstream adoption and pattern-mining queue. The result is part of the permanent upstream adoption governance and is verified by executable repository tests.
exclusions: No source incorporation without a separate bounded approval.
No dependency is represented as active solely because it was selected.
objective: Create prioritized upstream adoption and pattern-mining queue
observability_impact: Upstream adoption state becomes queryable and auditable.
rationale: The supplied upstream catalog is an implementation input. This work makes the adoption decision explicit and machine-verifiable so mature upstream capabilities cannot be silently ignored or falsely represented as integrated.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Revert registry/gate changes together and regenerate indexes; never leave selection/usage states inconsistent.
security_impact: Strengthens dependency/source provenance and blocks unsafe or unreviewed adoption.
title: Create prioritized upstream adoption and pattern-mining queue
